in_marathi.name: Bhavar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Feeling
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bhav' which means 'to be'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to have the ability to experience and express deep emotions. In Hindu mythology, Lord Bhavar is the deity who represents feelings and emotions.
